review.notes: Full re-review. The three findings, three corrections and two format notes of the previous review are repaired. One new finding (P2): Weierstrass's sigma function is planned as an owned target in 5.1 although ModularCurvesPartII 1.4a on main owns it. Sample: all fifteen seeded sections; about 55 DLMF equation and table numbers and Whittaker-Watson 23.7 (pp. 570-572) read at their locators; Dassios, Gesztesy-Holden, Ronveaux and Kristensson not readable. Recomputed: the zeros and Stieltjes residuals of 4.3, the discriminant values of 5.4, the Fourier ratio of 3.2, the order-k^4 splitting of a^2 - b^2 in 5.3, the one-dimensional orthogonality relations of 6.2, the reduction of the double orthogonality to SpecialFunctionsHeun 6.2. Suppliers resolved at their heads; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning (22); one-tactic probe closes none. Two automatic checks set aside as false positives (choice in lameHermitePoly; the header over the #check lines).
